metadata.description: Local Apple-framework skills for documents, extraction, logs, classification, search, speech, translation and image cutouts. No API fees for local processing.

plugins.name: ocr
plugins.description: On-device OCR with Apple Vision: Claude reads an image's text without the image leaving your Mac.

plugins.name: pdf-to-text
plugins.description: On-device PDF text extraction (PDFKit + Apple Vision OCR): Claude reads the text, not page images, and the PDF stays on your Mac.

plugins.name: table-to-csv
plugins.description: Extract tables from PDFs and images into CSV on-device with Apple Vision.

plugins.name: extract
plugins.description: Extract named fields from documents in bulk on-device, with source quotes and missing values.

plugins.name: condense
plugins.description: Condense long logs and test output locally, preserving exact failures and source lines.

plugins.name: classify
plugins.description: Classify or tag batches of text on-device with Apple Foundation Models.

plugins.name: local-search
plugins.description: Search selected local documents with Apple sentence embeddings and return source passages.

plugins.name: transcribe-audio
plugins.description: Transcribe audio and video locally into text, timestamped JSON or WebVTT subtitles.

plugins.name: translate
plugins.description: Translate text and JSON string catalogs locally with Apple Translation or Foundation Models.

plugins.name: image-cutout
plugins.description: Isolate an image subject locally using a point or bounding box, producing a transparent PNG and mask.
